incident-bot: Pager: High-rate SSE disconnects observed on /v1/stream (us-west-2). Error spike started ~08:12 UTC, affecting streaming and function-calls. Paging on-call.
alice (oncall): ack. I'm jumping in. link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-20876
bob (sre): seeing same in logs. connection reset (ECONNRESET) from proxy -> runtime. prepping timeline.
carol (eng-runtime): any recent deploys to stream runtime in us-west-2? I see a canary rolled ~07:58 but flagged green.
dave (support): customers reporting truncated function-call responses and reconnect loops. support ticket count = 12 and growing.
alice (oncall): quick impact summary? which customers and % of streams failing?
monitor-bot: metric snapshot: streaming_error_rate: 0.47 -> baseline 0.01, spike started 1700s ago. active_streams_down: ~320.
bob (sre): collecting pcap + proxy logs. saving sample traces to /artifacts/2087654321/traces.tar.gz
bob (sre): paste of proxy tail:
```
2026-02-15T08:11:58Z proxy[conn-421]: upstream reset id=0x7f2 err=ECONNRESET bytes=1024
2026-02-15T08:12:01Z proxy[conn-427]: 502 downstream chunked -> client disconnect
```
carol (eng-runtime): runtime logs show repeated tool-call parse errors right before disconnects:
```
2026-02-15T08:11:57Z runtime[streamer]: toolcall_parse_error id=abc123 payload="unexpected EOF"
2026-02-15T08:11:59Z runtime[streamer]: kv-cache miss, opening new connection
```
alice (oncall): starting live RCA thread here. Hypotheses below — add evidence or refute inline.
carol (eng-runtime): HYPOTHESIS 1: malformed tool-call JSON from some clients causing runtime to close stream. Evidence: `toolcall_parse_error` logs.
bob (sre): HYPOTHESIS 2: proxy/multiplexer is dropping connections under a certain sequence (paging edge case). Evidence: ECONNRESET in proxy + high conn churn.
dave (support): customer examples include both official SDK and a cURL client. Not limited to one client.
carol (eng-runtime): reproduced locally with fuzzed tool-call fragments; certain truncated chunk boundaries cause parser to throw and we close connection. Adding a small fix patch to tolerate EOF between frames. Patch candidate: `streamer: treat unexpected EOF as transient, don't drop whole session` (PR #4042).
bob (sre): meanwhile, mitigation: enable fallback routing to streaming-v2 (older runtime) for us-west-2 by tag. Running `rb route set --service streaming --region us-west-2 --tag fallback-v2` now.
alice (oncall): applied. monitor-bot: route change shows temporary drop in error rate to 0.09 within 3m.
carol (eng-runtime): rolling patch to runtime now (hotfix). smoke tests in canary pass.
alice (oncall): coordination: support -> tell customers we have a mitigation and are deploying a fix. dave, please send templated update.
dave (support): on it. message drafted: "We're seeing intermittent streaming disconnects, mitigation activated (fallback routing). Engineers deploying fix, ETA 15m. Will update." :thumbsup:
bob (sre): timeline so far: 07:58 canary deploy -> 08:11 first error spike -> 08:15 fallback routing -> 08:21 hotfix canary -> 08:28 full rollout.
carol (eng-runtime): Post-mitigation checks: increased parser robustness + add metric `toolcall_parse_failures` with client_user_agent label.
alice (oncall): closing loop: once rollout finishes, let's compile timeline + attach logs and hypotheses to INC-20876. Who will write RCA draft?
carol (eng-runtime): I can draft the tech RCA (root cause + patch) if bob adds timeline and artifact links.
bob (sre): I'll attach traces and host-level metrics. dave, please add customer impact notes and ticket list.
dave (support): will add ticket ids: #4521 #4523 #4527 and short impact notes.
alice (oncall): thanks all. final check: last observed elevated error rate at 08:38 UTC. marking incident as mitigated but not yet resolved. leaving thread open for RCA draft.
incident-bot: Incident INC-20876 status updated: mitigated -> owners: carol, bob, dave. Logs: https://artifacts/redwood/INC-20876
